worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.summar: Stomp the frustration of a missed attack into the ground: a fissure tears toward the target, throwing everyone standing on it up and outward; if your previous move whiffed, this stomp doubles and the far end caves in again.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.use.0: Tear a fissure toward the target
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.use.1: Throw everyone standing on the seam into the air
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.use.2: Answer a whiff with a doubled stomp
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.descri: Stomp the ground and send %1$s physical (Ground) power down the fissure; only grounded targets are caught.
The fissure reaches %1$s blocks with a half-width of %2$s; anyone on it is thrown up at %3$s blocks/tick and pushed out %4$s blocks.
The ground scar lingers %1$s across %2$s cells.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.deep.o: Current: Deep stomp — fissure width x1.25, launch x1.15, scar x1.3, but lower power, slower start and longer cooldown.
Current: Shallow stomp — a narrow, fast seam that hits harder once.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.growth: At level %1$s the stomp power rises to %2$s.
At level %1$s the stomp power rises to %2$s and the launch to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.prefer: On: fissure width x1.25, launch x1.15, ground scar x1.3 to seal a path, but power x0.92, fissure x0.95, +3 prepare and +8 cooldown. Off: narrow and fast, hitting harder once.
Only stomp when the target is within this distance; raise it to walk toward farther targets.
On: right after a missed attack, prioritise the doubled stomp; off: rank it as an ordinary melee move.
worldcombat.skill.stompingtantrum.descri: After your previous attack on a foe fully misses, frustration gathers on the user for about 5.5 s; a Stomping Tantrum thrown in that window doubles its power. Any successful hit dispels the frustration at once.
